**Coaching note:** When your rooks are doubled on a file and your opponent has a piece there, look for forcing captures that put the enemy king in immediate danger. Here, after R8xe1+, White's king cannot escape the harassment. The follow-up Re1+ traps it. Doubled rooks on an open file are one of the strongest attacking patterns in chess—use them aggressively!
